returnInterest.note: If I ever happen to be back in Rome, I will go and see the inside of the Basilica and museum.

description.intro: Vatican City is a small independent city-state surrounded by Rome and is known for its religious significance, historic influence, and remarkable architecture. Although I only spent a limited amount of time there, I was impressed by the scale and appearance of its landmarks. The experience left me interested in returning someday to see more of the interior attractions.
standouts: The architecture and landmarks were very impressive.
The line to enter the Basilica was extremely long.
tips: Consider getting a skip-the-line ticket if you want to visit the main attractions.
thingsToKnow: The main visitor-accessible sites are St. Peter's Square, St. Peter's Basilica, and the Vatican Museums.
personalNotes: I only visited St. Peter's Square because the queue to enter the Basilica wrapped around the entire square.
Everything looked very impressive from the outside.

transportNotes: The Vatican is really small, so you can easily walk around.
languageNotes: The official languages are Latin and Italian.

notes: Visited early January and the weather was quite nice, although the wind could get a little chilly.
